result.instructions: This server provides a structural model (ontology log) of the TypeScript codebase at /Users/wilbrt/projects/ologmcp/packages/mcp-server. Use olog_query to search for elements by kind/name/module. Use olog_inspect to get details and connections for a specific element. Use olog_dump for an overview. Use olog_reindex to refresh after code changes. The name and module parameters in olog_query accept JavaScript regex patterns.
